subsections.title: Revenue and Taxes
starts: Chief feature of the financial system: land revenue (BPSC 1999) – usually 1/6 of produce, 1/4 or 1/3 on fertile land; land-tax documents = A
Neerarambamu / Magani (irrigated): tax in grain, higher; Kaadarambamu / Metta (dry): cash, lower.

starts: Biggest unit: Mandalam (RPSC 2012) – not Kottam, Nadu or Kurram.

subsections.title: Army, Forts and the Nature of the State
starts: Two divisions: the Siddha (standing) army under the Dalavayi (via Kandachara), paid every 4 months, and the Amaranayaka contingents.
Bukka I = first to use cannon; Saluva Narasimha introduced Samugaris (gunmen).
